gizmo.title: Umdlalo wenkumbulo
gizmo.description: Jika amakhadi ukufumana izibini. Dibanisa igama nentsingiselo yalo ukuze ukuhambelana kubonise ukuqonda, okanye usebenzise izicatshulwa ezimbini okanye imifanekiso ehambelanayo.

configure.title: Isihloko
configure.description: Umyalelo oboniswa kwisihloko, umzekelo: Dibanisa igama nomsebenzi walo.

configure.title: Izibini
configure.description: Isibini ngasinye ngamakhadi amabini ahambelanayo, ngesiqhelo igama nentsingiselo yalo. Icala lifuna isicatshulwa, umfanekiso, okanye zombini.

advanced.title: Umbala wogxininiso
advanced.description: Umbala ongakhethwa wetshiphu yesihloko, umva wamakhadi neqhosha.
